P0_insertBefore_crash_fix.details: No console errors during DAMA kit generation or success screen display. The insertBefore crash was caused by programmatic download (.click()) during React state update - now fixed by using direct <a href> link.

DAMA_kit_generation_flow.details: Complete flow tested: select empresa (HC IMPORTAÇÕES), fill item number (1), fill value (100.50), upload PDF, click GERAR KIT LICITAÇÃO, success screen appears

ZIP_download_button.details: Download button is an <a> tag with data-testid='download-zip-btn', href='blob:...' URL, and download attribute with filename

multi_PDF_upload.details: File input has 'multiple' attribute, allows selecting multiple PDF files

success_screen.details: Shows 'Kit Licitação Pronto!' with stats: Órgão, Processo, Itens, Empresa, Valor Unitário, Moeda

nova_proposta_reset.details: Clicking 'Nova Proposta' resets form: clears item number, value, uploaded files, and blob URL

rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: React 'insertBefore' crash when generating DAMA kit
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Programmatic download using .click() on a dynamically created <a> element during React state update caused DOM manipulation conflict
rca_of_the_issue.fix_implemented: v66.0 removed useRef and downloadLinkRef, removed automatic download trigger, changed 'Baixar ZIP' button from <button onClick> to <a href={blobUrl}> direct link
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Tested complete DAMA flow multiple times - no console errors, success screen displays correctly, download link is functional
